description: Defines the class 'Image_Canvas_WithMap' which extends 'Image_Canvas' to add support for HTML image maps and related drawing functionalities.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
classes.description: A class extending Image_Canvas to include image map features and drawing methods such as lines, polygons, rectangles, ellipses, pieslices, text, and image overlays.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the canvas and optionally creates an image map if 'usemap' parameter is true.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a splined vertex to a polygon and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the image and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image and updates the image map if present.

methods.name: getImageMap
methods.description: Returns the image map object if it exists.
